newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end sharply up on technical rebound.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end sharply up on technical rebound.

text.p: Manila shares closed up on Thursday sustaining its rise for the second day as low-priced issues triggered broad-based buying, traders said.
"Definitely, this is a technical rebound. We have to see if this upward trend will continue," said Raul Ruiz, vice-president for research at Sun Hung Kai Securities.
The main index broke the 3,000 resistance level, climbing 77.49 points, or 2.60 percent, to 3,061.06 points at the close.
"Most blue chips were firm and there was some foreign buying," Teresa Lee, assistant vice-president at Lippo Securities said.
The property sector, battered in the past two weeks, led the rise with Ayala Land B up by 1.50 pesos to 28.50 pesos. All sectors rose except for oil.
Traders said the technical correction may persist until Friday. "We have to wait for a few more days to see if the sentiment has really been reversed," Lee added.
